references.text: The children of Israel cried out to the Lord during their slavery in Egypt, and God heard their cry for help.
The Lord heard his people's cry and came down to rescue them from Egypt.
The angel of the Lord went ahead of the camp of Israel as they left Egypt.
God promised to send an angel before the people to lead them to the promised land.
God sent an angel ahead of the people of Israel to drive out the Canaanites.
Moses reminded the people that they cried out to the Lord, and he heard them and brought them out of Egypt.
Kadesh is mentioned as the place where the spies returned to Moses and the assembly.
The people of Israel came to the wilderness of Kadesh, which is on the border of Edom.
The angel of the Lord saved them and carried them through all the days of old.
Stephen tells how God heard Israel's cry and sent Moses to lead them out of Egypt.
